newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade dips, RTF features.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade dips, RTF features.

text.p: Share trade on the Latvian stock exchange dipped on Friday with Riga Transport Fleet (RTF) in focus on high turnover.
Overall market trade came to 309,132 lats and RTF rose to two lats from 1.81 on turnover of 143,246 lats.
Usual official list leader Unibanka turned over 51,488 lats and was stable at 3.20 while confectionery maker Staburadze turned over 1,271 lats and dipped five santimes to 2.95.
The secondary list was led by Daugavpils Chain which rose to 2.15 lats from 2.11 on 36,055 lats while Mangali Shipyard saw trade of 21,015 lats and rose to 1.06 from 93 santimes.
Kaija fish cannery was active on 19,410 lats but dipped to two lats from 2.15 and Kurzeme Lock traded 8,719 lats as it gained to 42 santimes from 37.
Other active shares included Salacgriva on turnover of 7,077 lats with a fall to 4.59 lats from 5.40 while Jekabpils Sugar traded 5,812 lats and was stable at 60 santimes.
Rigas Raugs yeast maker lost 13 percent as it fell to 4.16 lats on turnover of 3,161 lats and Daugavpils Fostery added two santimes to 16 santimes on activity of 3,496 lats.
